book.name: Matai
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Matai byex o

content: Yesu neil qayeeng lek lukendu
Yesu yei xel qendu ngandoung on lam, om moxo lek la lukendu nenyawes. Ka e la dei, e xe xel betiyeing lam wou e.
Om moxo teyoxe wou xel me neil,
“Anutu bo mata wou xel wei woulek bei xel kanyo eivek nund laweeng o, en tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu eno inyon xel xe.
“Anutu wong mata la wou eti yeiw wei mi wo talot o, en tyek bo xel laleind vevop.
“Anutu wong mata la wou eti yeiw wei mi beoux xow o, en tyek bong tembuing tambak wou xel.
“Anutu wong mata la wou eti yeiw wei mindei maxep me kwend mi tip en sakwaing bombek o, en tyek bong e na teyei lek wou xel.
Anutu wong mata la wou eti yeiw wei lalei pyaweing o en tyek talex lalei pyaweing wou xel.
Anutu wong mata la wou eti yeiw wei laleind wo vako yo, en tyek xel gyei Anutu.
“Anutu bo mata wou eti yeiw wei mi leis qayeeng mey me wo lalei vevopeing wou xomaxoneing o, en tyek xel taxe xel bei Anutu neuyeiw.
“Anutu bo mata wou eti yeiw wei mi qou nimaying en sakwaing bombek o, en tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu eno inyon xel xe.

“Anutu bo mata wou xam gyeik xel xomaxoneing embei bo nol wou xam o me na neil qayeeng nilul lek xam, me bo nimaying me tyonyeing lek xam me na neil qayeeng leimalei dalus wei nilul o lek xam en xam ghe mi betiwou ay.

Xam laleimim embo nimza me ghe bong xeimimlala, en xam xe xouveing ngandoung toundei eivek tyoung gheyapu, en eivek sakwaing ambei nyon eno xel wo nimaying wou xel poropet eti yeiw wei la tax en xam o.
Xam on nambei mileeng me xeiyaing

“Xam on nambei mileeng wei tembuing o. Ekom wangwei nenyeing wei mileeng on na ma, on tyek xam ghe bong vati wou me mileeng enox bong nenyeing no? Inyon tyek se nox bo nimza no, om xam banex ena myayaing me xel xomaxoneing bakei lek.
“Xam on xeiyaing wei tembuing sapa yo. Beyeeng ngandoung wei toukale lek qetyei eno se teyei bei ghupek.
Xomaxoneing se mi byex eivek lam me toung ela xeinghembi eivek dipek. Qe xel mi lax lek vaxa wei mi nale lek o, me mi wong xeiyaing wou xel dalus wei mindei eivek xomek lalei yo.
Om nambei nyon eno xam ghe bong xam xe xeiyaing etel atax wou xomaxoneing mendghalus, en kandek xel gyei xam xe kwa nimza yon me sanghoxe xam Mamim lei eivek tyoung gheyapu.
Qayeeng petieing wo neing lek
“Xam seng bou kwamim bei a lam bei semaleeng qayeeng petieing veil o qayeeng poropet. A se lam bei semaleeng qe a lam bei bong embo neing lek.
A neil wou xam zonghek, ka tyoung gheyapu luw tembuing nati, tyek qayeeng nayaka ti tyek se nati, o dee nayak wei xel byex eno tyek se nati veil petieing qe ka lulul dalus na teyei lek bole.

Om wangwei xelti embei gyei qayeeng petieing ne nayak ti nambei lul bandaing me na teyoxe xel valu me xel bong ambei nyon, eno tyek e lei bo nayaka eivek tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu nei, ekom eti yeiw wei mi betiwou me teyoxe xel moux alis vex en petieing o, eno tyek xel a neil e lei bo ngandoung eivek tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu nei.

Om a neil wou xam bei wangwei xam se betiwou kwa bombek wei Anutu xe yo, me xam xe kwa bombek se ghanaw kwa bombek wei xel Parisi me xel putoung wei petieing, ond xam seng teyei being na eivek tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu yo.
Qayeeng wei leiseing xel a mey o
“Xam ghe ngo bei inyon qayeeng wei xel neil wou bumyeiw on takwei nei yo, ‘Xam seng nyeis xel amey, me e tiwei leis nge mey eno tyek bale lek qayeeng.’ Qou e loum 20:13

Ekom a neil wou xam eti yeiw wei laleind mi wo myavanei wou liyeiw ba eno tyek bale lek qayeeng. A neil no, eti yeiw wei neil qayeeng nol lek liyeiw ba eno tyek na gyei lei ngandoung wei kanzol o. Ekom wangwei tambiy ti e neil, ‘Wang on bandol!’ eno tyek na eivek nenyex wei beyeeng nilul o.
“Nambei nyon om wangwei wa being na toung xound lek qeind, ekom wang wou naleim bei lim neil qayeeng ti lek wang,
ond wa toung wa xe da e na mya wou qeind. De wang nox me na bole me menyex qayeeng is lim, woyom wang noum me ghe na toung wa xe da.

“Wa menyex wou qayeeng daing is tambiy wei embei qou wang me na bong qayeeng en wang o. Wang bong inye gyeik ingwei muw anghei di la wou sakwaing o, enok na qou wang me na wou tambiy wei mi ngo qayeeng o, me tambiy wei mi ngo qayeeng eno bong wang na wou beyeiv, me xel a toung wang na eivek xeitueing.
A neil wou wang zonghek, tyek wa seng teyei bei na myayaing, qe ka wa dexouv xomek xeitueing en wa xe malew kayo dalus bole.
Qayeeng wei kwapesiv o
“Xam ghe ngo qayeeng wei xel neil o, ‘Xam seng bo kwapesiv.’ Qou e Loum 20:14
Ekom a neil wou xam bei eti yeiw wei mi yei vex me lalei mi zeim e lek en vex eno inyon wong kwapesiv is e woy eivek lalei.
Wangwei wa mam payeiv bo wang bong sewokeing, ond wa qepei veil me banex ena. Inye nimza bei wa saing neing ti na veil de xel se banex wa neing dalus na eivek beyeeng wei nilul o.
Me wangwei wa memam payeiv e bo wang bong sewokeing, ond qateiv veil me nex ela. Inye nimza bei wa saing neing ti de xel se banex wa neing dalus na eivek beyeeng wei nilul o.
Qayeeng wei qateiveing iingama yo
“E neil is ambei nye, ‘Xelti embei qateiv luw venei xe iingama ond e bong qapiya wei qateiveing iingama yo ti wou e.’ Petieing 24:1
Ekom a neil wou xam, eti bei qateiv iingama wei luw venei, gyeik venei se wo kwa nol, ond wo venei wong ambei vex wei mi wo kwapesiv o, me eti bei dii vex wei qateiv iingama eno wo kwapesiv is e.”
Xam se neil zonghek is inyapunei

Yesu neil no, “Xam ghe ngo bei inyon xel neil wou bumyeiw takwei nei, ‘Wa se pyalek qayeeng wei wang neil zonghek is inyapunei yo, qe xam ghe gweiteyei qayeeng zonghek is inyapunei wei xam ghe neil wou Tambiy Ngandoung o.’
Ekom a neil wou xam, xam se neil qayeeng zonghek is inyapunei. Xam se neil tyoung gheyapu nei bei byexaxoun qayeeng ti, en inye Anutu xe siaking,
o xam se neil lek tembuing, en inye e xe pom wei mi lax vaxa lek o, o xam se neil lek Yerusalem, en inyon beyeeng ngandoung wei King wei ghanaw veil o.
Me wa se neil qayeeng zonghek is inyapunei lek lumkanzek, en wa seng teyei bei bong lum velus ti bo teleing o bo ngak.
Qe wa mou neimbei ‘E’ o wa neimbei ‘Ma.’ Qayeeng wei xel mi tetulexe eno lam wou tambiy kawei nilul o.
Xam seng bong myaveweeng nox me na

“Xam ghe ngo qayeeng wei xel neil o woy, ‘Wangwei xelti embo nol wou wa mamghalus, ond wang bo nol wou e manghalus is ambei nyon, me wangwei xelti qatuw wa newoum apek ond wa qatuw e newou pek is ambei nyon.’ Qouloum 21:24
Ekom a neil wou xam bei xam seng bong myaveweeng nox wou xel wei nilul o. Wangwei xelti petapexe wa ling nge payeiv, ond wa pekwi ling valu nox wou e is.
Me wangwei xelti embei bo qayeeng en wang me na qou wa xe teimb, ond wang bong e qou wa xe teimb ding is.
Wangwei tambiy ti tendu wang bei wa qalei e xe qoupek me ghe na teyei lek kilomita ti, ond wang na is e teyei lek kilomita yuw.
Wangwei tambiy ti teling wang en lulti yon wang bong wou e, de tambiy ti embei qou lulti wou wang dekakom bong enoum on wa se pesek.
Wa laleim devind xel vevek amba
“Wang ngo ingwei xel neil o woy, ‘Wa laleim devind nimpapu de ghe gwei xel wei vevek amba bo nol.’
Ekom a neil wou wang, wa laleim devind xel wei vevek amba yo me na zeimemam en eti yeiw wei embei bo nol wou wang o,

om nambei nyon xam on tyek mendei nambei Mang wei toundei eivek tyoung gheyapu yo neuyeiw, eno moxo mi wong sayeiv mi siing lek xel nilul me nimza, me wong luing mi tei lek xel wei bombek o me xel wei se bombek o is.
Wangwei wa laleim devind eti yeiw wei laleind mi vind wang, on tyek wa qou xouveing vati? Beip xel wei mi qou takis eno se mi wong inyon?
Me wangwei wa neil bendiyeing wou limyeiw venaxow, on tyek wa qou lul vati ghanaw xel valu? Xel wei mendalus eno se mi wong inyon is?
Xam a mi mendei embo nimzayang, nambei xam Mamim wei tyoung gheyapu mindei nimzayang o.
